title: Mixing: Cuff Link by Wings | 1977
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Wings mixed ‘Cuff Link’ for the London Town album on 12 December 1977.

Although considered finished at the time, Paul McCartney reviewed all the album mixes over Christmas, and eventually decided to remix the track on 6 January 1978.
